Potential ST code:

```
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_WeldGapAlarm
VAR_INPUT
    Gap_Exceeded : BOOL;
    Weld_E_Stop_NC : BOOL;
    DebounceTime : TIME;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    Operator_Alert : BOOL;
    Weld_Soft_Start_Active : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR
    InitTimer : TON;
    DebounceTimer : TON;
    InitDone : BOOL; (* maybe not needed *)
    E_StopActive : BOOL;
END_VAR

// Implementation
E_StopActive := NOT Weld_E_Stop_NC;

InitTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#5s);
InitDone := InitTimer.Q;
Weld_Soft_Start_Active := NOT InitDone;

DebounceTimer(IN := Gap_Exceeded AND InitDone AND NOT E_StopActive,
              PT := DebounceTime);
Operator_Alert := DebounceTimer.Q;
```
